**Experimental.** fit_bayes() delegates sampling to CmdStan and requires
explicit Stan data; general lavaan-to-Stan conversion is not implemented.
Prior configuration is not fully wired or validated against Stan data, and
current status checks do not enforce a full sampling-diagnostics policy.

R-hat, ESS, divergence, treedepth, energy and predictive checks would be needed
before interpreting a future Bayesian run. No sampling is executed here and
no Bayesian result is claimed. prior_predict is Not Implemented.
